error: No application error or out-of-memory condition was emitted by the FP32 full run; it was externally terminated after 10 of 961 frames at the user's request.
attempted_fixes: The AMP smallest-frame gate failed with: !all_profile_res.empty() assert faild. can't find suitable algorithm for 0
Disabled AMP while retaining FlashAttention off and patch sizes 64; the 30263-point smallest frame completed in 8.613 seconds.
Ran the 270720-point largest frame with the same FP32 settings; it completed in 35.381 seconds without OOM.
Started the 961-frame FP32 validation after both gates passed, then stopped promptly when the user limited sustained GPU load.
blocker: The user requested that sustained GPU load stop. At the stop checkpoint the GTX 1660 was at 99% utilisation, 3184/6144 MiB and 66 C; no Pointcept process remained after termination.
recommendation: Do not restart a full local GPU run without explicit approval. If a complete benchmark is still required, use a lower-load schedule or another CUDA machine, keep the protocol fixed, and recompute complete-split metrics under the repository definition.
notes: The two FP32 one-frame gates demonstrate bounded inference on the GTX 1660, but their scores and the rolling first-10-frame values are diagnostics only, not benchmark metrics. The full attempt has no End Evaluation marker and Pointcept's zero-union averaging differs from this repository's mIoU definition. Generated configs, predictions and logs remain on F: outside Git.
